format: UTF-8 CSV, comma delimiter, header row, decimal point. Empty cells mean explicitly documented not-applicable/unreported values; NaN/Inf are invalid.

meshFamily.description: Category or identifier. Method and ordering meanings are defined in methods.json.

boundaryMode.description: Category or identifier. Method and ordering meanings are defined in methods.json.

level.description: Category or identifier. Method and ordering meanings are defined in methods.json.

mode.description: Category or identifier. Method and ordering meanings are defined in methods.json.

ordering.description: Category or identifier. Method and ordering meanings are defined in methods.json.

host.description: Category or identifier. Method and ordering meanings are defined in methods.json.

job_id.description: Category or identifier. Method and ordering meanings are defined in methods.json.

profile_path.description: Path relative to the dataset root to the exact 1200-point sampled pressure profile.

N.description: Resolution parameter: N is total longitudinal cells for layered cases, or cells per Cartesian cube edge for sphere cases. cellsPerWavelength is cells per acoustic wavelength.

cellsPerWavelength.description: Resolution parameter: N is total longitudinal cells for layered cases, or cells per Cartesian cube edge for sphere cases. cellsPerWavelength is cells per acoustic wavelength.

ranks.description: Number of MPI processes; 1 denotes a serial run.

n_samples.description: Number of included sample points, all with valid probe flags.

hOverLambda.description: Nominal cell size divided by acoustic wavelength.

h_over_lambda.description: Nominal cell size divided by acoustic wavelength.

maxNonOrthogonality.description: Maximum cell-face nonorthogonality angle in the mesh.

max_nonorthogonality_deg.description: Maximum cell-face nonorthogonality angle in the mesh.

avgNonOrthogonality.description: Average cell-face nonorthogonality angle in the mesh.

avg_nonorthogonality_deg.description: Average cell-face nonorthogonality angle in the mesh.

pressureRelL2.description: Relative combined complex-pressure L2 error. Cell-volume weighting is used for homogeneous/sphere studies; see methods.json.

pressureRelLinf.description: Maximum complex-pressure error magnitude divided by maximum analytical complex-pressure magnitude.

velocityRelL2.description: Relative L2 error of the complex velocity vector, with the same cell-volume weights as pressure.

velocityInteriorRelL2.description: Velocity L2 error over the indicated cell subset; interior cells are more than 2.5 nominal cell widths from the boundary.

velocityBoundaryRelL2.description: Velocity L2 error over the indicated cell subset; interior cells are more than 2.5 nominal cell widths from the boundary.

pressureOrder.description: Observed order log(E_coarse/E_fine)/log(h_coarse/h_fine). Empty at the first level, where no preceding level exists.

velocityOrder.description: Observed order log(E_coarse/E_fine)/log(h_coarse/h_fine). Empty at the first level, where no preceding level exists.

pressureRelL2_cell_centres.description: Combined complex-pressure relative L2 error at cell centres, distinct from the manuscript 1200-point sampled norm.

baselineDifference.description: Relative complex-pressure L2 difference from the original serial baseline field for the same physical configuration.

parallelDifference.description: Relative complex-pressure L2 difference between the indicated run and the serial field of the same method, in serial cell ordering.

liquidRelL2.description: Relative complex-pressure L2 error over the indicated cell subset; see archived sphere/advanced.py metrics definition for the interface band.

gasRelL2.description: Relative complex-pressure L2 error over the indicated cell subset; see archived sphere/advanced.py metrics definition for the interface band.

interfaceRelL2.description: Relative complex-pressure L2 error over the indicated cell subset; see archived sphere/advanced.py metrics definition for the interface band.

seconds.description: Comparison-driver elapsed wall time; a single timing measurement, not a scaling result.

max_relative_residual.description: Maximum true assembled relative linear-system residual over correction sweeps. Empty only for frozen baseline runs that did not report this diagnostic.

sigma_max_s_inv.description: Positive maximum PML damping magnitude. Some original reports print its negative implementation coefficient.

P_relL2.description: Combined real/imaginary pressure L2 error over 1200 uniformly weighted samples including the PML.

Pre_relL2.description: Real or imaginary pressure component L2 error, normalized by the corresponding analytical component norm.

Pim_relL2.description: Real or imaginary pressure component L2 error, normalized by the corresponding analytical component norm.

x_m.description: Sample position along the layered domain, including endpoints.

Pre_sim.description: Real or imaginary component of numerical (sim) or analytical complex pressure.

Pim_sim.description: Real or imaginary component of numerical (sim) or analytical complex pressure.

Pre_analytic.description: Real or imaginary component of numerical (sim) or analytical complex pressure.

Pim_analytic.description: Real or imaginary component of numerical (sim) or analytical complex pressure.

p_abs_sim.description: Magnitude of numerical or analytical complex pressure at the sample point.

p_abs_analytic.description: Magnitude of numerical or analytical complex pressure at the sample point.

z_m.description: Piston on-axis sample distance from the baffle (the solver axial direction is y).

z_over_rayleigh.description: Axial distance divided by Rayleigh distance R0=k*a^2/2.

p_sim_pa.description: Piston on-axis numerical or analytical pressure magnitude.

p_analytic_pa.description: Piston on-axis numerical or analytical pressure magnitude.

p_sim_over_p0.description: Piston on-axis pressure magnitude divided by rho*c*u0.

p_analytic_over_p0.description: Piston on-axis pressure magnitude divided by rho*c*u0.

theta_deg.description: Polar angle from the piston axis, ranging from zero to 90 degrees.

SPL_sim_dB.description: 10*log10(0.5*|P|^2/(20e-6 Pa)^2), using RMS pressure from the complex peak amplitude.

SPL_analytic_dB.description: 10*log10(0.5*|P|^2/(20e-6 Pa)^2), using RMS pressure from the complex peak amplitude.

directivity_sim.description: Far-field pressure magnitude divided by its on-axis value for the same curve.

directivity_analytic.description: Far-field pressure magnitude divided by its on-axis value for the same curve.

p_far_abs_sim_pa.description: Numerical or analytical far-field pressure magnitude at r_far_m.

p_far_abs_analytic_pa.description: Numerical or analytical far-field pressure magnitude at r_far_m.

p_far_real.description: Real or imaginary component of pressure reconstructed by the Kirchhoff integral.

p_far_imag.description: Real or imaginary component of pressure reconstructed by the Kirchhoff integral.

r_far_m.description: Radius of the exterior far-field sampling arc.

time.description: Stationary solver output index; not elapsed physical or wall-clock time.

relL2.description: Piston near-field relative L2 or Linf error of the pressure magnitude, using the uniformly sampled on-axis profile.

relLinf.description: Piston near-field relative L2 or Linf error of the pressure magnitude, using the uniformly sampled on-axis profile.

absLinf.description: Maximum absolute error of piston pressure magnitude after normalization by rho*c*u0; despite the column name it is dimensionless.

farField_pressureMagnitude_relL2.description: Relative L2 error of far-field pressure magnitudes over the sampled polar angles.

farField_onAxisAmplitude_relError.description: Signed numerical/analytical on-axis far-field magnitude ratio minus one.

h_over_a.description: Target cell size near the sphere divided by sphere radius.

segments.description: Number of generating semicircle surface segments.

n_surface_faces.description: Number of acoustic mesh faces on the sphere boundary.

cell_size_m.description: Target cell size next to the rigid-sphere surface.

drop_cell_size_m.description: Target cell size next to the rigid-sphere surface.

position_m.description: Sphere-centre coordinate along the standing-wave axis.

position_mm.description: Sphere-centre coordinate along the standing-wave axis in millimetres.

numerical_force_y_N.description: Integrated numerical axial radiation force in the archived whole-sphere convention. Multiply by 1e15 for plotted fN.

gorkov_force_y_N.description: Analytical rigid-Rayleigh-sphere Gorkov axial force for the documented excitation.

numerical_to_gorkov.description: Signed ratio of numerical to analytical axial force.

absolute_relative_error.description: Absolute force difference divided by absolute Gorkov force, for nonzero-reference cases.

difference_from_gorkov.description: Absolute force difference divided by absolute Gorkov force, for nonzero-reference cases.

difference_normalized_by_peak_force.description: Absolute force difference divided by the peak analytical force over position; finite at analytical zero crossings.

change_to_next_finer.description: Absolute force change to the next finer grid divided by that finer-grid force magnitude. Empty on the finest grid.

force_at_1Pa_N.description: Archived integrated axial force for the stated incident pressure amplitude.

force_at_1000Pa_N.description: Archived integrated axial force for the stated incident pressure amplitude.

force_at_1000Pa_div_1e6_N.description: 1000-Pa result divided by 1000^2 for comparison with the 1-Pa force.

relative_scaling_deviation.description: Relative deviation from the expected quadratic pressure-amplitude scaling; original archived statistic.

matrixNonzeros.description: Stored entries in the PETSc real block matrix, including both pressure components.

mumpsFactorMemorySumMB.description: Summed factor-memory diagnostic INFOG(22); not total process peak memory.
